preconditions.description: The number of nodes n in the tree s must be between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (ai, bi) must connect two distinct nodes within the range of 1 to n.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1, ensuring the structure is a tree.

postconditions.description: The number of nodes m in the T-decomposition must be at least 1.
Each node xi in the T-decomposition must contain at least one node from the original tree s.
The union of all nodes in the T-decomposition must equal the set of all nodes in the original tree s.

postconditions.expression: all(any(a in xi and b in xi for xi in decomposition_nodes) for a, b in edges)
postconditions.description: For every edge (a, b) in the original tree s, there must be a node xi in the T-decomposition that contains both a and b.

postconditions.expression: all(any(a in xi for xi in decomposition_nodes) for a in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: Every node a from the original tree s must be included in at least one node xi of the T-decomposition.
